title: A fresh final VERIFIER's CLEAR settled a block that stage pre left open

found.context: Live runs of the untested 0.5.0 paths on the demo project: the final VERIFIER pass

observed_failure: Stage pre ended at its round cap with M6 SUSPECTED and blocking: no record says the normalizations use the mean and standard deviation. Nobody decided it. At stage final a fresh VERIFIER, which by design does not see the pre reports, judged the same unchanged records CLEAR, and GI_PRE_UNRESOLVED accepted that, so the block disappeared without a fix or a decision.
expected_behavior: A mode the last stage-pre round left blocking stays a GI final error until GI pre is re-run clean or a named person's decision is recorded in audits/integrity/pre/decisions.json. A later CLEAR alone does not settle it, because two fresh contexts can judge the same records differently.

resolution.summary: integrity_check.py fails stage final on any mode still blocking in the last stage-pre report without a stage-pre decision

lessons: Variance between model contexts is not evidence: a verdict that flips with nothing changed needs a person, not a re-roll.
